paragraphs: I'm a **Full-Stack Developer** with **{{years}}+ years of experience**, building everything from offline-first mobile apps to modern web platforms for healthcare and enterprise clients.

Currently at **Intergy Consulting**, I build full-stack web applications for the Australian **healthcare and aged-care** sector using **React, Next.js, Python and Django** — including exam portals, therapy-scheduling tools and support-worker allocation systems.

Previously at **Nanosoft Engineers**, I led React Native development for apps serving **2,000+ field technicians**, specializing in offline-first architecture, encrypted storage and custom sync logic.
I'm continuously expanding my stack — currently deepening **Django** and exploring **Strapi CMS** and **Salesforce** integrations.
